about: 재고1 원본 재기 — 판매입력은 단가 0 인 줄도 저장한다(원본 2026-10-21 실측). API 로 단가 0 판매를 올려 201 을 보고 바로 지운다.

shots.name: 단가 0 판매 저장 → 지움
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const [ps, its, whs] = await Promise.all([g('/api/partners'), g('/api/items'), g('/api/warehouses')]); const today = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const r = await fetch('/api/sales', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ partnerId: ps.find((p) => p.type !== 'SUPPLIER').id, warehouseId: whs[0].id, saleDate: today, remark: 'QA재고1 단가0', lines: [{ itemId: its.find((i) => i.type !== 'SERVICE' && !i.lotManaged).id, quantity: 1, unitPrice: 0 }] }) }); const b = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); sessionStorage.setItem('zp', JSON.stringify({ st: r.status, id: b.id })); if (b.id) await fetch('/api/sales/' + b.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return true })()
